method: Automated inventory read every source, evidence, pathway, profile and review record in the exact manifest candidate for this ISO.

Automated screening compared source references, locators, geography fields, evidence class, direction, status, horizon and scenario; it checked pathway support IDs, link-evidence sets, geography fields, alternatives and uncertainty for follow-up.

source_refs.locator: One-based PDF pp. 14–16, climate trends and locations repeatedly hit by extremes

evidence.compact_statement: Source dated 2021-09 reports: The NAP reports 1961–2018 warming (annual 0.4–1.2°C; growing-season up to 1.4°C), rising heavy-rainfall share and variability; it names Trebinje, Zenica, Laktaši and Sanski Most among repeatedly affected towns.
recommendations: No wording change is indicated by the record-only check; keep the claim provisional until its cited passage is independently reopened.

source_refs.locator: One-based PDF p. 34, recent floods in the Sava Basin

evidence.compact_statement: Source dated 2021-09 reports: Record May 2014 rain plus snowmelt broke Sava embankments and flooded Central Posavina, Odžačka Posavina and Semberija; later heavy rain caused repeat flooding and landslides.
recommendations: No wording change is indicated by the record-only check; keep the claim provisional until its cited passage is independently reopened.

source_refs.locator: One-based PDF p. 41, modeled future peak streamflows

geographies: BiH tributaries of the Sava River Basin
evidence.scenario: RCP8.5; upper-quartile 100-year daily-rainfall value; end of the 21st century.
evidence.compact_statement: Source dated 2021-09 reports: Under RCP8.5, upper-quartile 100-year daily rainfall implies at least 23% higher end-century 100-year peak flows across modeled BiH Sava tributaries.
recommendations: No wording change is indicated by the record-only check; keep the claim provisional until its cited passage is independently reopened.

source_refs.locator: One-based PDF pp. 12–13, legislative and spatial-planning review

evidence.compact_statement: Source dated 2021-09 reports: In 2021, the NAP found climate law and spatial planning insufficient; environmental powers lay with the entities and Brčko, and existing plans had not integrated climate change.
recommendations: No wording change is indicated by the record-only check; keep the claim provisional until its cited passage is independently reopened.
